label: Auto
what: Widget is set automatically by script variable type.

label: BoundingVolumeEditor
what: Editor which displays min and max bounds, also allows using the BoundingVolumeEditor. Type must be enf::DVT_OBJECT.

label: Button
what: Generic ".." button without default functionality. It's for custom GUI implementation only. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING or enf::DVT_INTEGER or enf::DVT_SCALAR.

label: CheckBox
what: Checkbox. m_strParams has no usage. Type must be enf::DVT_BOOLEAN.

label: ColorPicker
what: Color wheel picker. m_strParams has no usage. Type must be enf::DVT_COLOR or enf::DVT_VECTOR3.

label: ComboBox
what: Combobox. m_strParams has usage for numeric values, where there may be min and max value separated by space. There can be also optional "sortAlphabet" param that must be placed after min, max and step values. Enums may contain selectable values. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING, or enf::DVT_INTEGER or enf::DVT_SCALAR

label: Coords
what: 3-element vector type in X/Y/Z form. Type must be enf::DVT_VECTOR3.

label: CurveDialog
what: Editor for splines which opens a dialog where the curve can be edited. Type must be enf::DVT_OBJECT (CurveCubicSplineClass) or historically enf::DVT_VECTOR2ARRAY / enf::DVT_VECTOR4ARRAY.

label: Date
what: Date picker. m_strParams has no usage. Type must be enf::DVT_INTEGER. Format is provided by enf::DateTimeAsInt.

label: EditBox
what: Editbox. m_strParams has usage for numeric values, where there may be min and max value separated by space. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING, or enf::DVT_INTEGER or enf::DVT_SCALAR.

label: EditBoxMultiline
what: Edit box with a generic ".." button which is used to open separate window with text editor. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING.

label: EditBoxWithButton
what: Edit box with a generic ".." button which is without default functionality. It's for custom GUI implementation only. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING or enf::DVT_INTEGER or enf::DVT_SCALAR.

label: FileNamePicker
what: File name picker. m_strParams contains file extensions separated by whitespace. For folders there are reserved virtual extensions "folders".

label: Flags
what: Array of bit flags represented by checkboxes. m_strParams has no usage. Enums must contain bit definitions. Type must be enf::DVT_INTEGER.

label: Font
what: Font picker. m_strParams has no usage. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING.

label: GradientDialog
what: Editor for splines which opens a dialog where the curve can be edited. The spline will be visually represented as a color gradient where possible. Type must be enf::DVT_OBJECT (CurveCubicSplineClass) or historically enf::DVT_VECTOR2ARRAY / enf::DVT_VECTOR4ARRAY.

label: Hidden
what: Property is hidden when None is used. Same as UIWidgets.None.

label: LODFactorsEdit
what: Dedicated to edit LOD factors. Type must be enf::DVT_SCALAR_ARRAY.

label: LocaleEditBox
what: Editbox for picking up IDs from localization table. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING.

label: None
what: Property is hidden when None is used.

label: Object
what: Single object or an array of objects (depends on variable definition). Type must be enf::DVT_OBJECT or enf::DVT_OBJECTARRAY with objects. Use "noDetails" parameter with it to remove extra information from GUI (ClassName + goto Prefab button).

label: Range
what: 2-element vector type in min-max form. Type must be enf::DVT_VECTOR2.

label: ResourceAssignArray
what: Array of name-ResourceName pairs. Uses resource picker. m_strParams contains file extensions separated by whitespace

label: ResourceNamePicker
what: Registered resource picker.

label: ResourcePickerThumbnail
what: Registered resource picker with thumbnail support.

label: Script
what: Small script preview and button which opens ScriptEditor to edit script property. Type must be enf::DVT_STRING.

label: Slider
what: Slider. m_strParams may contain min, max and step values separated by space. Type must be enf::DVT_INTEGER of enf::DVT_SCALAR.

label: SpinBox
what: SpinBox. m_strParams may contain min and max value separated by space. Type must be enf::DVT_INTEGER or enf::DVT_SCALAR.

label: TopLevelObject
what: Single object or an array of objects (depends on variable definition). Type must be enf::DVT_OBJECT or enf::DVT_OBJECTARRAY with objects. When type is enf::DVT_OBJECTARRAY, there is no GUI of the array variable visible, but GUI of the array members will be placed on the top level of hierarchy. All ancestors and descendant objects (depends by context) will be editable.
